data: Powerful electric energy arcs out from you, hitting any creature in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become paralyzed. Creatures in range that are in flight or in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce take double damage from this move.
Works better the more excited the crowd is.
You gain Appeal points equal to the crowd meter level plus 1.
